# SemVer excludes build metadata, so `+echo.N` is ordered on the build number
1.2.3 < 1.2.3+echo.1
1.2.3+echo.1 < 1.2.3+echo.2
1.2.3+echo.2 < 1.2.4
1.2.3+echo.9 < 1.2.3+echo.10
1.2.3+echo.1 = 1.2.3+echo.1

# the base SemVer ordering still applies
1.2.3+echo.2 < 1.3.0+echo.1
2.0.0 > 1.9.9+echo.5

# a pre-release is still lower than the release it precedes
1.2.3-rc.1+echo.1 < 1.2.3+echo.1
1.2.3-rc.1 < 1.2.3-rc.1+echo.1

# build metadata that is not Echo's is ignored, per SemVer
1.2.3+build.1 = 1.2.3+build.2
